raise_InternalError: raise an InternalError exception with a message and optional original exception for compiler errors
raise_LiftedCompilationError: raise a LiftedCompilationError with source code, AST, and original exception for lifted AST compilation failures
log_errors_to_disk: configure error logging to disk by setting the BEANSTALK_LOG_ERRORS_TO_DISK environment variable to 1
enable_verbose_exceptions: enable verbose exception output by setting the BEANSTALK_VERBOSE_EXCEPTIONS environment variable to 1
write_error_to_temp_file: write an error message string to a temporary file on disk using the internal _log_to_disk helper
